1. Find the band of pixels within the reach of the selection edge, with the exact distance transform.
2. Rank each band pixel: edges at least as strong as the contrast setting rank by strength, above all others.
3. Rank weaker pixels higher the nearer they are to the old edge.
4. Flood the band from both sides in rank order. The floods meet on the strongest edge.
5. Smooth the result by majority, then soften the edge by one pixel.
